$comment: requires_bootstrap is the bootstrap release that first recognizes the llm_kit shared library as first-party for the transient-import retry (engine._FIRST_PARTY_LIBS), shipped in the same bootstrap publication as this plugin. The copied code binds bootstrap_lib call shapes first shipped no later than bootstrap 0.154.1 (the claudx REFUSE edge), so 0.157.0 covers them. llm_kit is the only shared library this plugin publishes; the legacy libraries llm_scripting_kit, content_pipeline and job_kit keep their owning plugins and are never imported here. No config block: llm-kit seeds no user config and reads the legacy credential and config locations unchanged. The one custom script, custom_bootstrap.py, only checks the OpenRouter credential (reading those locations, never writing them) and records an unmet or rejected key as a deferred requirement in this plugin's own data directory; it migrates no legacy .env or data directory and seeds no layer. The venv carries every extra the bundled code reaches and the llm-kit console script (pyproject [project.scripts]); the standalone interpreter carries only the .pth links. The git tool is declared because the jobs group creates and reclaims per-attempt git worktrees.
